title: XposedMIA: Exploiting Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for One-Shot Membership Inference Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.12067v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) services increasingly expose explainability outputs alongside model predictions. While such explanations are intended to improve transparency, they may also reveal information about the underlying training data. In this work, we show that the local surrogate geometry employed by Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) can be repurposed as a proxy for a sample's distance to the model's decision boundary. We extend this boundary-distance view to tabular counterfactual explanations and, for the first time, to visual counterfactual explanations for image classifiers. We present XposedMIA, a one-shot, explanation-based black-box membership inference attack (MIA) framework that converts the returned explanation into a proxy for the queried sample's distance to the model decision boundary. translated_title: XposedMIA：利用可解释人工智能（XAI）实现单次成员推断攻击
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）服务越来越倾向于在模型预测的同时输出可解释性结果。虽然此类解释旨在提升透明度，但它们也可能泄露有关底层训练数据的信息。在本工作中，我们证明了局部可解释模型无关解释所采用的局部代理几何结构可以被重新用作样本到模型决策边界距离的代理指标。我们将这一边界距离视角扩展到表格反事实解释，并首次扩展到图像分类器的视觉反事实解释。我们提出了XposedMIA，这是一个单次、基于解释的黑盒成员推断攻击框架，它将返回的解释转化为被查询样本到模型决策边界距离的代理指标。在仅包含30个样本的小型带标签校准集上进行一次校准后，我们的攻击只需要……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出XposedMIA攻击框架，首次将LIME局部代理几何及表格和视觉反事实解释转化为样本到决策边界距离的代理指标，仅需30个样本进行一次性校准即可实施单次黑盒成员推断攻击，揭示了可解释性输出泄露训练数据成员信息的隐私风险。
en_tdlr: XposedMIA is a one-shot black-box membership inference attack that repurposes LIME surrogate geometry and tabular/visual counterfactual explanations as proxies for a sample's distance to the decision boundary, requiring only a one-time calibration on as few as 30 samples.
